label: Basic
description: Basic dropdown menu. Best for plain text rows in 2 groups, the first headed My Account, with a disabled API row.

label: Opening Positions
description: Menus opened from different places. Best for 3 triggers in a row, each opening the same rows in a sheet named for where it came from: on a phone a menu rises from the bottom.

label: Icons
description: Dropdown menu with icons. Best for a leading icon on each row and a destructive Log out set apart in its own group.

label: Keyboard Shortcuts
description: Dropdown menu with keyboard shortcuts. Best for key caps after every row of a short account list, for a hardware keyboard.

label: Nested Submenus
description: Dropdown menu with a submenu. Best for a single Invite users row between Team and New team, opening Email, Message and More in place, with a way back.

label: Checkboxes
description: Dropdown menu with checkboxes. Best for 3 panel toggles, each bound to its own boolean, with the Activity bar one disabled; the sheet stays open as they change.

label: Radio Groups
description: Dropdown menu with radio items. Best for an exclusive pick of panel position among 3 arrow icon options, with Right disabled.

label: All Item Types
description: Every item kind together. Best for an Open recent submenu, a theme radio set in a submenu, a checkbox and a delete.

label: User Profile
description: User profile menu. Best for a named account button opening an avatar and email header over profile, team, help and log out rows.

label: Notification Feed
description: Notification feed menu. Best for a bell with a count badge, 3 avatar activity rows with times and unread marks, and a Mark all as read button.

label: Record Actions
description: Record actions menu. Best for record actions on a vertical dots button: edit, duplicate, a move to submenu, share, copy link and delete.

label: Share & Export
description: Share and export menu. Best for a labelled Share button whose rows split into share channels and PDF, CSV or PNG export, ending in Print.

label: Theme & Status
description: Account menu with a theme switch and status. Best for an account sheet with an icon theme switch in its header, count rows and a presence radio set.

label: User & Create
description: Create and account menus. Best for a New button for customer, order and invoice records beside a bare avatar trigger for profile, billing and sign out.

label: Quick Actions
description: Quick actions menu. Best for a borderless horizontal dots button named More options, with Settings, Share and a destructive Remove.

label: Notification Items
description: Notification items menu. Best for a ghost bell button opening 3 one line alerts, the first with a trailing tick.

label: Workspace Switcher
description: Workspace switcher. Best for switching among 3 workspaces shown by logo, name and plan, with a tick on the active one and a create row.

label: AI Model Selector
description: Model picker with provider icons. Best for a Select model button listing 3 AI models by provider tile, with a tick on the chosen one.
